name: residual-preservation-211
launchCondition: All-hero rule-generated fixtures, regression tests and CUDA smoke pass.
hypothesis: Preserve unused hero-specific card capabilities when a legal ordinary attack at the same target has identical local attack behavior. No refinement exploration. Not guaranteed long-term dominance.
initialization: Same AI 1.5.1 checkpoint; fresh identical Adam/RNG. Both use corrected terminal-v1 rules.

development.report: All four checkpoints and paired between-arm endpoint difference; seven lineups and hero/mixed controls. Reused development only.

decision: Evaluate both arms at 96 and 192 with no inference bias. Report all-hero conservation opportunity/chosen rates, active-skill counterexamples, team and mixed win rates; no automatic promotion/deployment. Future refine-only trial must require zero own energy; not launched.

bias.equivalence: same elements, or empty target hand with no own elemental seal; matching current effects; known active skills excluded
bias.applies: training only; no added reward; replay exact behavior distribution
